channel.title: GRAI Licence Register Tracker — CraicBet
channel.description: Daily updates from the official GRAI gambling licence register in Ireland, tracked by CraicBet.

item.title: Full register audit: 42 licences confirmed, newest dated 16 October 2026
item.description: We read all 42 licence entries on grai.ie and matched every company and licence number against our list, with no discrepancies. The newest licence is dated 16 October 2026; none has been issued since. Issue dates for every licence are now listed on the tracker.

item.title: GRAI chief executive says the authority has acted against dozens of unlicensed operators since July
item.description: GRAI chief executive says the authority has acted against dozens of unlicensed operators since July — from small Irish bookmakers to major online firms and the two largest prediction markets in the world — with most ceasing trade after cease-and-desist warnings. A GRAI/ESRI survey finds almost 4 in 10 people who opened accounts to bet on sport or racing went on to other forms of gambling (Irish Times, 4 Nov 2026).

item.title: GRAI reported to have warned the Minister that a funding shortfall will delay remote gaming (online
item.description: GRAI reported to have warned the Minister that a funding shortfall will delay remote gaming (online casino) licensing: application systems are now reported to be expected in early 2027 rather than late 2026 (Irish Times report, 30 Sep 2026).

item.title: Tracker launched. Register carries remote betting and betting intermediary licences only; no remote
item.description: Tracker launched. Register carries remote betting and betting intermediary licences only; no remote gaming (casino) licence has been issued to date.

item.description: Media report GRAI interventions leading several offshore platforms to geo-block Irish users, with refunds supervised for affected customers; 100+ operators reported under investigation.
